newsitem.title: PERU: PERU'S FIRST HALF FISHMEAL OUTPUT UP 6.5 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: PERU'S FIRST HALF FISHMEAL OUTPUT UP 6.5 PERCENT.

text.p: Peru produced 1.137 million tonnes of fishmeal during the first half of the year, up 6.5 percent compared with the same period in 1996, the Fisheries Ministry said Friday.

Production of Peru's second most important fish product, raw fish oil, was 242,600 tonnes during the January to June period, down 5.1 percent compared with the same period last year, the ministry said in its monthly report.
Peru produced 147,400 tonnes of fishmeal in June, down 27.2 percent from the same month last year.
Raw fish oil production during June was down 46.9 percent to 29,600 tonnes, compared with June 1996.
Peru, which has stepped up its exports by drawing down stocks in early 1997, was expected to exploit its April- September quota by July, according to the independent Oil World newsletter.
Peru, the world's largest fishmeal and fish oil maker, produced 1.885 million tonnes of fishmeal in 1996, up 5.4 percent from 1995.
